en.summary: Synchronizes the SDP EW LUT/interpolation subpaths so parallel x, line/expn, and flow pipelines move in lockstep, and restores the missing throughput-2 LUT FIFO specialization.
why_it_counts: The substantive changes are all in DUT datapath RTL, not in tests or tooling.
The patch ties valid/ready behavior together across parallel subpaths that are later recombined, which is a correctness issue under backpressure.
The large LUT file delta adds a missing throughput-2 implementation branch, which also affects DUT behavior for a real build configuration.
evidence: All touched files are SDP DUT RTL files: NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v, NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v, and NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v.
In NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v, the fix changes input and output handshakes so LUT x, LE, and LO paths only advance together and only retire together.
In NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v, the fix introduces inp_flow_prdy/flow_pipe3_prdy gating so the flow and interpolation result paths also stay synchronized before asserting inp_out_pvld.

In the parent version of NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v, throughput handling jumped from NVDLA_SDP_EW_THROUGHPUT==1 directly to the throughput-4 implementation; the fix inserts an explicit throughput-2 branch.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This datapath forks one input into multiple parallel subpaths: an x/value path, LUT index/line-or-expn paths, and a later interpolation/flow selection path. Those subpaths must consume inputs and retire outputs in lockstep, because their results are recombined into one output transaction. If ready/valid is allowed to progress independently on any subpath, backpressure can make one branch advance ahead of the others, so the recombined output pairs mismatched x, fraction, or interpolation data. In this source repository, the same fix set also restores a missing throughput-2 FIFO implementation, which is a configuration-specific manifestation of the same EW datapath correctness problem.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: lockstep ready/valid coordination across parallel compute subpaths
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Backpressure or skew on a datapath that forks one transaction into parallel lookup/interpolation branches and later recombines them into one output; optionally, builds with a distinct throughput-2 buffering mode.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop the cross-coupling terms that force all parallel subpaths to accept and retire data together; optionally remove the dedicated throughput-2 buffering specialization so a wrong buffering structure is used for that build.
portability_notes: The most reusable injection is the handshake desynchronization, because it maps to any design that forks work into parallel subpipes and then rejoins them.
Keep the arithmetic datapath unchanged; only relax the ready/valid coordination so mismatched sub-results are still possible under backpressure.
If the target DUT has per-throughput specializations, a second optional mutation is to bypass the throughput-specific branch and reuse a buffer implementation sized for another throughput.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the fork/join region where one input transaction is sent into multiple parallel subpaths whose outputs are later recombined into a single valid/data channel.

Remove the gating terms that require every subpath to be ready before asserting the shared input ready, and remove the terms that require every subpath to be valid before asserting the shared output valid or ready.
If the design also has a separate buffering implementation for a lower-throughput mode, optionally force that mode to fall through to a buffer structure intended for a different throughput.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: SDP EW LUT/index/interpolation handshake and throughput-specific FIFO selection
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix rewires NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v and NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v so parallel subpaths share coordinated ready/valid conditions, and it adds an explicit NVDLA_SDP_EW_THROUGHPUT==2 branch in NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v, restore the old independent lut_in_prdy/lut_final_pvld style equations; in NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v, restore the old direct inp_in_prdy and inp_out_pvld equations without inp_flow_prdy/flow_pipe3_prdy coordination; and for throughput-2 builds in NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v, remove the explicit #elif (NVDLA_SDP_EW_THROUGHPUT==2) branch so the file falls back to the old non-2-specific implementation.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under EW backpressure or throughput-2 configuration, the LUT x path, line/expn path, and interpolation/flow path can become misaligned, leading to dropped outputs, stalls, or outputs built from mismatched sub-results.
evidence_for_injection: The new idx-path equations require lo_line, le, and lut_x paths to be ready together on input and valid together on output.
The new inp-path equations similarly require the flow tag pipeline and the chosen result path to agree before inp_out_pvld is asserted.
The parent LUT file lacked any explicit throughput-2 branch, and the fix inserts one between the throughput-1 and throughput-4 implementations.
notes: For cross-DUT reuse, the handshake desynchronization is the primary injection because it does not depend on NVDLA-specific file generation.
The throughput-2 branch removal is a secondary, repository-grounded mutation that is useful when the target design also has per-throughput specializations.

zh.summary: 该提交同步了 SDP EW 中 LUT/插值各子路径的握手，使并行的 x、line/expn 和 flow 管线保持锁步，同时补上了缺失的 throughput-2 LUT FIFO 特化实现。
why_it_counts: 实质性修改全部发生在 DUT 数据路径 RTL 中，不涉及测试或工具链。
补丁把多个后续会重新汇合的并行子路径的 valid/ready 绑定在一起，这是回压下的真实正确性问题。
虽然 LUT 文件改动很大，但其中新增的是缺失的 throughput-2 实现分支，会影响真实 build 配置下的 DUT 行为。
evidence: 所有修改文件都是 SDP 的 DUT RTL：NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v、NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v 和 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v。
在 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v 中，修复把 LUT x、LE 和 LO 三条路径的输入/输出握手改成了只有同时就绪才前进、只有同时有效才退休。
在 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v 中，修复引入了 inp_flow_prdy/flow_pipe3_prdy 门控，使 flow 标签路径与插值结果路径在拉高 inp_out_pvld 前保持同步。
NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v 的父版本在 throughput 处理上从 NVDLA_SDP_EW_THROUGHPUT==1 直接跳到 throughput-4；该修复补入了显式的 throughput-2 分支。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这条数据路径会把一个输入事务分叉到多条并行子路径：x/value 路径、LUT index 的 line/expn 路径，以及后续的 interpolation/flow 选择路径。由于这些结果最终会重新组合成一个输出事务，所以所有子路径都必须锁步地接收输入、锁步地退休输出。如果某条子路径可以独立推进 ready/valid，那么一旦遇到回压，就可能出现某一支先走、另一支没走的情况，最终输出会把不匹配的 x、fraction 或插值结果拼在一起。在这个源码仓库里，同一次修复还补上了缺失的 throughput-2 FIFO 实现，这是同一类 EW 数据路径正确性问题在特定配置下的体现。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 并行计算子路径之间的锁步 ready/valid 协调
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条会把单个事务分叉到多个 lookup/interpolation 子路径、最后再汇合成一个输出的管线遇到回压或时序偏斜；或者 DUT 具备独立的 throughput-2 缓冲模式。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除强制并行子路径同时接收和同时退休数据的交叉门控项；可选地，再移除专用的 throughput-2 缓冲分支，让该配置误用其他 throughput 的缓冲实现。
portability_notes: 最可复用的注入是握手失同步，因为它可以映射到任何“分叉后再汇合”的并行子管线。
保持算术数据路径本身不变，只放松 ready/valid 的协调关系，让回压下的错配组合成为可能。
如果目标 DUT 也有按 throughput 分化的实现，还可以作为第二个可选故障，把低吞吐专用分支绕回到其他 throughput 的缓冲结构。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把一个输入事务送入多条并行子路径、并最终重新组合成一个 valid/data 输出的 fork/join 区域。
删除“所有子路径都 ready 才允许共享输入 ready”为真的门控项，以及“所有子路径都 valid 才允许共享输出 valid/ready”为真的门控项。
如果设计对低 throughput 模式有单独缓冲实现，可选地让该模式回落到为另一种 throughput 准备的缓冲结构。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: SDP EW 中 LUT/index/interpolation 的握手协调以及 throughput 专用 FIFO 选择
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复重写了 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v 与 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v 的 ready/valid 关系，使并行子路径共享协调后的握手条件，并在 NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v 中补上了显式的 NVDLA_SDP_EW_THROUGHPUT==2 分支。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_idx.v 中恢复旧的、彼此独立的 lut_in_prdy/lut_final_pvld 方程；在 NV_NVDLA_SDP_HLS_Y_int_inp.v 中恢复旧的直接 inp_in_prdy 与 inp_out_pvld 方程，去掉 inp_flow_prdy/flow_pipe3_prdy 协调；并且对 throughput-2 构建，在 NV_NVDLA_SDP_CORE_Y_lut.v 中移除显式的 #elif (NVDLA_SDP_EW_THROUGHPUT==2) 分支，使文件重新回到旧的非 2 专用实现。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 EW 路径回压或 throughput-2 配置下，LUT 的 x 路径、line/expn 路径以及 interpolation/flow 路径会失去对齐，导致输出丢失、停顿，或者由不匹配的子结果拼接出错误结果。
evidence_for_injection: 新的 idx 路径方程要求 lo_line、le 和 lut_x 三条路径在输入侧同时 ready、在输出侧同时 valid。
新的 inp 路径方程同样要求 flow 标签管线与被选中的结果路径达成一致后，才允许断言 inp_out_pvld。
父版本的 LUT 文件没有任何显式 throughput-2 分支，而修复版在 throughput-1 和 throughput-4 之间插入了该分支。
notes: 为了跨 DUT 复用，首选注入应是握手失同步，因为它不依赖 NVDLA 特有的文件生成方式。
移除 throughput-2 分支属于第二层、以仓库为锚点的注入方式；当目标设计也有按 throughput 特化的实现时才更有意义。
